method_novelty_review.claim: This is a plug-in expected two-class Macro F1 rule for selecting whole probability-tie-block K values, not a novel general thresholding or positive-allocation method.
closest_prior_work: Round 1 searched inner-label-selected thresholds; those outcomes show that improved recall/positive allocation can reduce Macro F1.
Round 2 selected thresholds from inner labels and found that fixed 0.50 beat an over-allocating inner-pooled threshold on W2.
Optimization V2 fitted calibration/stacking heads at fixed 0.50 and did not search thresholds.
A02 matched-count controls ranked at K copied from another frozen arm's 0.50 positive count; B02 instead chooses K from plug-in expected two-class Macro F1.
method_novelty_review.limits: The objective is nonlinear and computed from expected confusion counts; it is neither exact expected Macro F1 nor a guarantee under calibration error or temporal/batch shift.

batch_scenarios.h12: origin67 full cycles 68-79 as a separate, overlapping batch scenario
batch_scenarios.overlap_warning: H12 rows overlap primary windows; scenarios are not independent holdouts
batch_scenarios.primary: five independent origin first-four-cycle windows; aggregate their fixed decisions with unchanged W1

recipe.eligible_present_rule: only candidate K values at ends of exact equal-probability blocks, plus zero and all
recipe.fixed_missing_rule: freeze missing-stream hard labels at that source's existing >=0.50 route
recipe.name: B02_LABEL_FREE_PLUGIN_EXPECTED_TWO_CLASS_MACRO_F1
recipe.qualification: adaptive diagnostic only; no candidate qualification, submission, or champion selection
recipe.selection_scope: each source and batch independently; probabilities and existing source recipes fixed
recipe.soft_confusion: S=sum(p) over all batch rows; fixed missing hard labels contribute expected TP/FP/FN/TN; present top-K contributes sum(p_topK) to TP and K-sum(p_topK) to FP; FN=S-TP; TN=N-S-FP
recipe.target_access: bank labels only for each origin's pre-origin OOF bank to reconstruct frozen B01 probabilities; query labels loaded only after every K and hard prediction is fixed
recipe.tie_break: maximize within 1e-12; then K nearest existing present-row >=0.50 positive count; then smaller K
